outputs.constraints:
DATES: OrderDate mixes 'YYYY-MM-DD' and 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; always wrap it as date(OrderDate) so the closing day is not dropped.
ENTITY GRAIN: group by the entity's id column (CustomerID, CategoryID, ProductID, EmployeeID, SupplierID) and select its display name.
REVENUE uses "Order Details".UnitPrice, never Products.UnitPrice.

inputs.question: Which category had the lowest total quantity sold in 2023? Return {category:str, quantity:int}.

outputs.sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, SUM(od.Quantity) q FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID=p.CategoryID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY c.CategoryID ORDER BY q ASC LIMIT 1
